name: lionfox_fixtl
description: Adds /fixtl for recovering players stuck mid-translocate. /fixtl clears the Entity.Teleporting flag (vanilla BlockEntityTeleporterBase.HandleTeleportingServer silently skips entities with the flag set, which manifests as 'translocator particles play but no teleport'). /fixtl unstick additionally clears EntityPlayer.ignoreTeleportCall (via reflection) and re-broadcasts position via TeleportToDouble — fixes the variant where warmup runs to completion but the player doesn't visually move after switching gamemodes (e.g. through spectator). /fixtl diag dumps Teleporting/IsTeleport flags, Pos vs ServerPos delta, MountedOn, ignoreTeleportCall, NoClip, and nearby teleporter BEs' tpingEntities entries. Admin subcommands: /fixtl status, /fixtl all, /fixtl player <name>.
